units.title: Finite Gaussian Hermite Gram formula
units.statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. Let \(H_j\) be the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial and put \(h_j(w)=[x\mapsto H_j(\langle w,x\rangle)]\in L^2(\gamma_E)\). For a finite set \(S\subset\mathbb N\) and real coefficients \(c_j\), put \(F_{S,c}(w)=\sum_{j\in S}c_jh_j(w)\). For every finite \(S\), arbitrary real \(c_j\), and actual unit vectors \(w,z\), the Hilbert inner product is the following diagonal sum. Signed correlations, both endpoint correlations, degree zero and empty support are included.
assumptions: The finite-dimensional real inner-product and Borel structures are the actual structures on the same carrier \(E\).
\(\gamma_E\) is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. No positive dimension restriction is imposed.
Both directions satisfy \(\|w\|=\|z\|=1\). They need not be independent or orthogonal.
\(S\) and the real coefficients are arbitrary; no parity, positivity, or total-mass normalization is imposed.

steps.title: Identify each class inner product with its Gaussian integral
steps.text: Use the actual \(L^2\) inner-product formula and the almost-everywhere representatives. Apply the existing mixed Hermite product theorem, including its endpoint and zero-degree cases.
steps.lean:
let k : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => ((j.factorial : ℝ) * (c j)^2) * ⟪w,z⟫_ℝ ^ j
  have hinner (i j : ℕ) : ⟪gaussianHermiteRidgeL2 i w, gaussianHermiteRidgeL2 j z⟫_ℝ =
      if i = j then (i.factorial : ℝ) * ⟪w,z⟫_ℝ ^ i else 0 := by
    rw [MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
    calc
      _ = ∫ x, aeval ⟪w,x⟫_ℝ (hermite i) * aeval ⟪z,x⟫_ℝ (hermite j)
          ∂stdGaussian E := by
        apply integral_congr_ae

      _ = _ :=

steps.title: Extract the coefficients
steps.text: Bilinearity moves the two real coefficients outside the class inner product. On the diagonal their product is \(c_i^2\); off the diagonal the Gaussian inner product vanishes.
steps.lean:
⟪c i • gaussianHermiteRidgeL2 i w, c j • gaussianHermiteRidgeL2 j z⟫_ℝ =
        if i = j then k i else 0 := by
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right, hinner]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [k]
      ring
    · simp [h]
  unfold finiteGaussianHermiteRidgeL2

steps.title: Collapse the finite double sum
steps.text: Expand the finite feature inner product in both coordinates. For each outer degree, only its identical inner degree contributes; that degree belongs to the same finite support.
steps.lean:
rw [sum_inner]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [inner_sum]
  simp_rw [hdiag]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i hi]
  · simp [k]
  · intro j _ hij
    simp [Ne.symm hij]
